run_npm_windows: run an npm command with arguments in a given directory on Windows using npm.cmd
run_npm_unix: run an npm command with arguments in a given directory on Unix-like systems
main: build the GUI frontend by running npm install and npm run build when BUILD_GUI is set
build_gui_frontend: build the GUI client frontend by setting BUILD_GUI=true and running the build hook script
run_npm_install: run npm install in the GUI client directory using the cross-platform npm runner
